account_access: An individual cannot authenticate, sign in, reset credentials, complete MFA, or regain control of their identity.
workspace_access: A signed-in person cannot enter a workspace, project, or resource because of membership, role, invitation, seat, or permission state.
cancel_subscription: The customer wants the paid subscription to end entirely or its next renewal prevented. This wins over a possible plan change when they say they are leaving.
plan_change: The customer wants to keep the subscription while changing tier, seats, cadence, or product edition.
duplicate_charge: Two or more completed/captured charges exist for the same purchase. A pending authorization or a single unfamiliar charge is not enough.
refund_status: A refund has already been promised, approved, or issued, and the customer asks about its timing, progress, or absence.
invoice_request: The customer needs a receipt, invoice, credit note, tax/VAT field, or other billing document; use this even when the document will support an expense dispute.
payment_method: A card, bank debit, or other payment instrument must be updated, has failed, or is being queried. This does not cover a confirmed duplicate charge.
technical_bug: A documented, existing CloudDesk capability behaves incorrectly. A request for an unbuilt capability belongs to feature_request.
feature_request: The customer asks for a new or expanded capability, including a workaround request when the current product lacks that capability.
